verdict.rationale: v0's own platform API docs describe programmatic access to all of v0's capabilities: code generation, chat, project management and deployment. The official vercel/v0-sdk shows concrete usage, with `v0.chats.create`, API-key auth via V0_API_KEY, and stream reading. That makes v0 drivable through a documented public API. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on community corroboration of driving v0 through the API, and per-endpoint detail such as rate limits or a deployment endpoint example.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: The v0 API gives you programmatic access to all of v0's capabilities, letting you integrate v0's AI-powered code generation, chat interface, project management, and deployment features into your own applications and workflows.
Set V0_API_KEY, or deploy server-side code on Vercel with OIDC enabled, then use the default client.
